ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure has two slanted lines p and q, and gives p ∥ q; an approximately vertical transversal passes through both p and q. The angle (3x - 60)° is located above line p and on the right side of the transversal; the angle (2x + 15)° is located below line q and on the right side of the transversal. Reasoning: Because p ∥ q, these two angles are on the same side and both are outside the two parallel lines, so they are same-side exterior angles and are supplementary. Therefore (3x - 60) + (2x + 15) = 180. Combining gives 5x - 45 = 180, so 5x = 225, solving gives x = 45.

raw_record.question_text: Refer to the figure at the right. Find the value of $x$ if $p \parallel q$.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as two slanted parallel lines p and q cut by the same transversal. The angle labeled (3x - 60)° is above line p on the right side of the transversal, and the angle labeled (2x + 15)° is below line q on the right side of the transversal. Since p ∥ q, these two are same-side exterior angles, so they are supplementary. Set (3x - 60) + (2x + 15) = 180 and solve for x, giving x = 45.

推理：因为 p ∥ q，这两个角在同一侧且都位于两条平行线外部，所以它们是同旁外角，互为补角。因此 (3x - 60) + (2x + 15) = 180。合并得 5x - 45 = 180，所以 5x = 225，解得 x = 45。

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as having angle y° below line p and to the right of the transversal, adjacent to the angle (3x - 60)° at the upper intersection. The angle y° corresponds to the lower angle labeled (2x + 15)° because both lie in the same relative position with respect to the transversal and the parallel lines p and q. Thus y = 2x + 15. At the upper intersection, y° and (3x - 60)° form a linear pair, so y + (3x - 60) = 180. Substitute y = 2x + 15 to get (2x + 15) + (3x - 60) = 180, so x = 45.
